[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Kanoth''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and an alchemist of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who, alongside [[Dominique|Lady Dominique]], become one of the leaders of the obscure Sith cult known as "[[The Unmasked]]". He was a worshipper of [[Darth Nihilus]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|Lord Kanoth|exp=lots|type=codex}}</ref>
